route_title: Periodic Quarter-Wave Stack for UV Reflection with SWIR Transmission
compilation_rationale: Bounded 24-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack optimized across 300–1700 nm. Thickness bounds set to 80–400 nm (~0.5–1.5× quarter-wave at band centers). Two mean objectives enforce passband transmission and stopband reflection simultaneously. Solver smatrix used for coherent planar propagation.
